meta.title: Shared visual explainer
meta.subtitle: Replace the per-run Remotion video with one shared skill that renders a fixed HTML page from props.

goal: Every plan, milestone gate and PR review gets the same animated HTML explainer. The agent writes only a props JSON file. A zero-dependency script validates it and renders one self-contained page.

architecture.summary: Three skills call one renderer. The renderer owns the page. The caller owns the facts.

components.name: multiphase-plan
components.role: Runs `plan` mode after it registers a plan, except for `light` plans.

components.name: loop-execute
components.role: Runs `ship` at the merge gate and `plan` at milestone resume. A detached runner writes the props.

components.name: pr-review
components.role: Runs `ship` in Step 4 instead of a Remotion video.

components.name: SKILL.md
components.role: How to author props, check every hand-test command against code, and publish.

components.name: Schemas
components.role: `plan.schema.json` and `ship.schema.json`. A hand-test step needs a `path:line` reference.

components.name: render.mjs
components.role: Validates props with field paths, then writes `index.html`.

components.name: page.html
components.role: Template with tokens, dark mode, reduced motion and fixed scene styles.

flows.label: escaped scene markup into fixed slots

milestones.title: One explainer for plans, gates and reviews
milestones.outcome: All three callers use the shared renderer. No Remotion, MP4 or browser render step remains.

phases.title: Add the renderer, schemas and template test-first
phases.doneWhen: `node --test tests/visual-explainer.test.mjs` covers field-path errors, escaping, both modes and the hand-test reference rule.

phases.title: Write the skill text and the example props
phases.doneWhen: The STE linter reports no hard violations. The examples render.

phases.title: Connect pr-review, multiphase-plan and loop-execute
phases.doneWhen: Each caller runs the right mode. A failed explainer never blocks a park or a resume.

decisions.decision: Animate with SVG and CSS inside the page.
decisions.why: The page opens anywhere, needs no render step, and respects reduced motion.

rejected.reason: Each run built a new project in `/tmp`. It was slow, each output looked different, and it broke easily.
It needs ffmpeg or a browser on the machine.

decisions.decision: The agent writes only props JSON.
decisions.why: Fixed scenes give the same look every run. One escaping function protects every field.

rejected.option: The agent writes HTML each run
rejected.reason: Each page differs, and props text could inject markup or script.

decisions.decision: A `ship` hand-test step must carry a `path:line` reference.
decisions.why: The milestone 2 checklist had the install before the dry run. The reference forces a read of the code.

rejected.reason: Nothing forces the author to check the order against the code.

risks.risk: A long plan makes a long page.
risks.mitigation: Sticky section navigation and a Play tour.

risks.risk: An explainer failure blocks a milestone park or resume.
risks.mitigation: The explainer runs best-effort. The notification states the failure.

risks.risk: A wrong code reference looks like proof.
risks.mitigation: The skill tells the author to open each referenced line before writing the command.
